summary: The dataset focuses on PRPH2, a gene mutated in 3-5% of inherited retinal degeneration cases, leading to retinitis pigmentosa and macular/pattern dystrophy. Researchers aim to elucidate PRPH2's role in outer segment formation and renewal, particularly in rods and cones, to understand disease mechanisms and develop effective therapies. To achieve this, they established mouse models and therapeutic platforms to investigate PRPH2 complexes, ROM1's influence on disc rim morphogenesis, and interacting partners contributing to diverse disease phenotypes.
